name: Wake-on-LAN
description: Powers on switched-off PCs via Wake-on-LAN (magic packet) - provided the device supports WOL and it is enabled in the BIOS/network card. The packet can be sent from the RMM server (backend) or from a node in the target's network. MAC addresses are detected automatically from the agent's metrics and can be extended. Adds the "Power on (WOL)" action to the agent panel.
author: BYTERA
